purpose: Determine whether the currently registered quarterly household-consumption response equation is source-admissible for Romania before any structural selection or parameter estimation.

household_final_consumption.concept: Final consumption expenditure of households and NPISH, Romania, quarterly, current prices, non-seasonally adjusted

household_gross_disposable_income.concept: Gross disposable income of households and NPISH, Romania, quarterly
household_gross_disposable_income.coverage_note: The indexed non-seasonally-adjusted series runs from 1999-Q1 through at least 2025-Q3.

examples.concept: Household consumption-loan APRC, new business, RON, monthly
House-purchase AAR/NDER, pure new loans, RON, monthly

borrowing_rate_boundary.rule: Do not select housing, consumption, outstanding-stock or a synthetic weighted borrowing rate after inspecting household-consumption fit. A future source contract must freeze the economically relevant rate family and monthly-to-quarterly aggregation before estimation.

BIS.documented_scope: Quarterly total-private-non-financial-sector DSR for 32 economies; household/NFC breakdown for 17 economies.
BIS.interpretation: The current BIS documentation explicitly lists the 17 economies with household/NFC DSR breakdowns and Romania is not among them. Do not substitute a total-PNFS series.

available_non_equivalent_Romania_measure.concept: Household loans as ratio of gross disposable income, annual
available_non_equivalent_Romania_measure.reason: Debt-to-income is a stock-to-income leverage measure. It omits scheduled amortisation and interest-payment burden and therefore cannot substitute for a debt-service ratio.

historical_microprudential_thresholds.interpretation: Regulatory borrower debt-service caps or indebtedness thresholds describe lending rules, not an observed aggregate household DSR history; they may not be inserted as the macro state variable.

bnr_dsti_alternative.concept: BNR bank-average DSTI levels for new and outstanding housing-loan portfolios
bnr_dsti_alternative.semantic_limit: Observed housing-loan borrower/portfolio burden, not definitionally identical to a macro household-sector DSR; new-loan and outstanding-loan measures must remain separate.
bnr_dsti_alternative.next_gate: Either retain exact machine-readable longitudinal housing-loan DSTI levels or preregister a publication-text-only alternative borrower-burden candidate family over 2023-Q1..2025-Q2, preserving source precision and keeping new versus outstanding loans separate.

transformation_boundary.rule: Do not choose nominal versus real growth, seasonal treatment, deflator, or lag structure from evaluation fit. These belong in a separate preregistered structural-selection contract only after the source boundary is complete.

reasons: The registered macro household DSR term is not identified by an exact Romania household-sector DSR source.

BNR housing-loan DSTI levels are directly observed in publication text for every quarter from 2023-Q1 through 2025-Q2, but they define a narrower borrower/portfolio burden concept and the exact machine-readable longitudinal level history has not been retained.
The household borrowing-rate concept is not uniquely defined by the registry and must be frozen ex ante.
Real/nominal and seasonal transformations for consumption and disposable income have not yet been frozen.
source_admissibility.nested_form_rule: Removing the DSR term or selecting an income-only/rate-only form requires a new preregistered candidate-family contract. Source incompleteness does not authorize dropping variables after seeing outcomes.

prohibited_shortcuts: Use household loans-to-disposable-income as a debt-service ratio.
Use a regulatory debt-service cap or borrower indebtedness threshold as an aggregate DSR observation.
Choose mortgage versus consumer borrowing rates after model fit.
Construct a synthetic household DSR from debt stock, a new-business rate and an assumed maturity without a separately preregistered measurement model.
Drop the DSR term and fit a nested equation merely because the DSR source is missing.
Choose seasonal adjustment, deflator or lag structure after opening evaluation outcomes.
